Fixture: dead-links

Exercises the dead-links check in ai-kit-docs-sync-dead-links.sh.

Expected: exactly 2 broken markdown links in docs/architecture.md.
1. Line referencing ./legacy-install.md (relative resolution)
2. Line referencing /missing-root.md (repo-absolute resolution)

Expected to be SKIPPED (not findings):
- External https URLs
- Anchor-only #... links
- Image links ![alt](src)
- Links inside fenced code blocks
- Bare URLs without markdown syntax
- HTML <a href> tags

This file is .txt so the docs-sync scanner does not read it as markdown.
